title: Billing Executive
description:
**Job Summary**

We are looking for a detail-oriented and organized Billing Executive to manage billing operations and work order preparation within our confectionery business. The candidate will be responsible for preparing and processing work orders, generating invoices, maintaining accurate transaction records, and coordinating with relevant departments to ensure smooth billing operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Create and process work orders based on approved requirements, production schedules, and business instructions.
* Prepare and verify invoices, ensuring the accuracy of product descriptions, quantities, rates, and applicable charges.
* Coordinate with production, procurement, warehouse, inventory, and accounts teams for billing and work order processing.
* Maintain systematic records of work orders, invoices, purchase orders, and delivery challans.
* Monitor work order status and follow up with concerned departments to ensure timely execution and closure.
* Update billing transactions and work order details using MS Excel, ERP systems, or billing software.
* Assist in identifying and resolving billing discrepancies and mismatches in transaction records.
* Prepare periodic billing and work order reports for management review.
* Ensure compliance with established billing procedures and documentation standards.

**Preferred Qualification**

* **Graduate in Commerce, Business Administration**
  , or a related discipline; candidates with relevant practical experience may also be considered.
* **1–4 years of relevant experience**
  in billing operations, preferably in the
  **confectionery, FMCG, manufacturing, or distribution industry**
  .
* Practical experience in work order creation and processing is essential.
* Working knowledge of
  **MS Excel**
  and familiarity with billing
  **software or ERP systems**
  .
* Basic understanding of invoicing, purchase orders, inventory documentation, and reconciliation.
* **Good numerical accuracy**
  , attention to detail, and organizational skills.
* Ability to coordinate with multiple departments and meet operational deadlines.
* Suitable for junior to mid-level professionals seeking an opportunity in confectionery manufacturing operations.

description:

* Vehicle Finance Loan is a growing business for Ujjivan SFB. The Cluster Manager - Vehicle Finance Loan is an important position that will drive this business in the respective cluster. The position is responsible for overall growth and success of the business in the cluster.
* Build efficient team of Relationship officers/Business Correspondents in the clusters assigned

* In coordination with the Credit & Product teams, identifies suitable branches and locations for VF business loan and gets the locations activated. Ensures proper goal setting, resource planning, marketing and sourcing of VF business.

Key Responsibilities: - Maintain and update financial records, ensuring accuracy and compliance with accounting standards. - Prepare and file GST returns and manage all aspects of taxation. - Perform bookkeeping tasks, including accounts payable and receivable, payroll, and bank reconciliations. - Assist in the preparation of financial statements and reports for management review. - Collaborate with other departments to ensure financial accuracy and provide support for budgeting and forecasting. - Stay updated on changes in tax laws and regulations to ensure compliance. Required Skills: - Proficiency in Tally and other accounting software. - Strong understanding of GST and taxation regulations. - Excellent bookkeeping skills and attention to detail. - Ability to analyze financial data and prepare reports. - Strong organizational and time management skills. - Good communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment. If you are a motivated professional with a passion for accounting and a commitment to accuracy, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.

title: Analyst, Specialist, Operations, Trns Svcs-Trade Operations, Corporate Banking, Technology & Operations
description:
**Business Function**
Group Technology and Operations (T&O) enables and empowers the bank with an efficient, nimble and resilient infrastructure through a strategic focus on productivity, quality & control, technology, people capability and innovation. In Group T&O, we manage the majority of the Bank's operational processes and inspire to delight our business partners through our multiple banking delivery channels.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Analyst will play a critical role in the end-to-end processing and operational management of Trade Finance products. Hired candidate will be responsible for ensuring high operational efficiency, accuracy, and adherence to global risk and compliance standards. This role supports key business areas including Purchase Invoice Discounting (PID), Supply Chain Finance (SBD/PBD), Letter of Credit Bills Discounting (LCBD), and Structured Product Solutions (SPS), contributing to the seamless delivery of trade solutions to our Institutional Banking Group (IBG) clients.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Operational Excellence: Ensure accurate and timely processing of trade transactions in accordance with service level agreements (SLAs).
* Risk & Compliance Management: Maintain rigorous compliance with the Group Trade Risk Control Standard, including Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Sanctions, and Trade Caution List checks.
* Client Delight: Provide superior operational support to internal stakeholders and external clients to ensure seamless trade execution.
* Process Improvement: Identify and support the implementation of operational efficiencies, including digital transformation and automation initiatives.
* Manage the end-to-end operational lifecycle for PID, SBD, PBD, LCBD, and SPS transactions.
* Perform detailed document verification and pre-checks to ensure all transaction details align with bank policies and regulatory requirements.
* Coordinate with internal departments (e.g., Credit, Relationship Managers, Client Service Managers) to facilitate trade flows.
* Monitor transaction status, investigate discrepancies, reconciliation and resolve queries within established timelines.
* Maintain comprehensive documentation for audit trails and regulatory reporting.
* Support the adoption of digital platforms and AI-driven tools to enhance operational speed and accuracy.

**Required Experience**

* 1–3 years of experience in Trade Finance Operations or a related banking operations field.
* Strong understanding of trade products, including Letters of Credit, Guarantees, and Supply Chain Finance.
* Proven experience in transaction processing, documentation, and operational risk management.

**Education/ Qualification**

* Bachelor’s degree in finance, Business, Commerce, or a related field.
* Professional certifications related to Trade Finance (e.g., CDCS or equivalent) are highly preferred

**Core Competencies**

* Customer Focus: Dedicated to meeting the expectations and requirements of internal and external clients.
* Drive for Results: Highly organized, proactive, and capable of managing multiple priorities under tight deadlines.
* Adaptability: Able to adopt new technologies and adapt to process changes rapidly.
* Attention to Detail: Meticulous approach to documentation and policy compliance.

**Technical Competencies**

* Proficiency in banking trade systems (e.g., Trade Finance processing systems, Core Banking systems).
* Strong command of MS Office suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
* Familiarity with digital banking platforms and trade automation tools is an advantage.

**Work Relationship**
Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams including Relationship Managers, Credit Risk, Compliance, Client Service Managers and Technology/Operations counterparts to ensure efficient delivery of trade services.
  
  
**DBS India - Culture & Behaviors**

* Be the Best: Always strive for excellence and maintain high standards in everything you do.
* Be Digital: Champion digital innovation and embrace new technology to improve processes.
* Be Purposeful: Understand the impact of our work on our clients and the broader community, and act with integrity and accountability.
* Collaboration: Foster an environment of teamwork, mutual respect, and shared success.

**Job:**

**Schedule:**

title: Senior Engineer Planning & Scheduling - PED
description:
It's about Being What's next.
**What's in it for you?**
The Engineer is responsible for providing comprehensive project controls leadership across planning, scheduling, cost management, budgeting, forecasting, risk assessment, and performance reporting for EPC and capital projects. The role ensures projects are executed within approved cost and schedule baselines through effective monitoring, analysis, stakeholder coordination, and implementation of project control best practices, while delivering accurate forecasting, commercial insights, and management information to support informed decision-making and successful project delivery.
  
  
At Linde, the sky is not the limit. Team
  
  

Making an impact.

title: Financieel Assistent Agro (24–40 uur)
description:
Wegens groei van de organisatie zijn wij op zoek naar een:
  
  
Financieel Assistent Agro (24–40 uur)
  
  
Over de functie
  
  
In deze functie ga jij het verschil maken richting ondernemers in de agrarische sector. Je krijgt gezonde dosis verantwoordelijkheid, ruimte voor ontwikkeling en dagelijks direct contact met klanten.
  
  
Als Financieel Assistent werk je in een hecht en betrokken team, waar jouw kennis en inzet direct bijdragen aan het succes van onze klanten. Je krijgt de vrijheid om je eigen werk in te richten en de kans om te groeien, zowel vakinhoudelijk als persoonlijk.
  
  
Wat ga je doen
  
  

* Zelfstandig samenstellen van (complexere) jaarrekeningen en tussentijdse cijfers.
* Opstellen van belastingaangiften (o.a. omzet-, inkomsten-, vennootschaps- en dividendbelasting).
* Signaleren van kansen en knelpunten voor klanten en deze vertalen naar praktisch advies.
* Opstellen van managementrapportages en ondersteunen bij klantbesprekingen.
* Actieve rol spelen in klantcontact: je bent aanspreekpunt en sparringpartner.
* Begeleiden en ondersteunen van junior collega’s en het delen van jouw kennis.
* Bijhouden van vaktechnische ontwikkelingen en meedenken over verbeteringen in processen.

Kortom: een veelzijdige functie waarin je verder kijkt dan cijfers alleen en écht impact maakt voor ondernemers.
  
  
Over het team
  
  
Je komt te werken in een betrokken en zelfsturend team bestaande uit ongeveer 50 collega’s, verdeeld over twee locaties; Staphorst en Hattemerbroek. Wij werken voor een diverse klantenkring waaronder het MKB en de Agrarische sector. Onze cultuur is open, sociaal en gedreven. Samen zorgen we ervoor dat we ondernemers écht verder helpen – en dat doen we met plezier.
  
  
Wat neem je mee
  
  

* Een afgeronde hbo-opleiding in Accountancy, Bedrijfseconomie, Bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbare financiële richting.
* Bij voorkeur 1 à 2 jaar relevante werkervaring in de samenstelpraktijk.
* Goede communicatieve en analytische vaardigheden: je spreekt de taal van de ondernemer.
* Affiniteit en/of belangstelling voor de agrarische sector
* Je bent proactief, kwaliteitsgericht en een echte teamspeler.

Wat krijg je van ons
  
  

* Een uitstekend salaris afhankelijk van je ervaring, aangevuld met vakantietoeslag, pensioen en aantrekkelijke secundaire voorwaarden.
* Flexibiliteit in je werkweek: de mogelijkheid om 24, 32, 36 of 40 uur te werken en je werkdagen zelf in te delen.

title: Associate General Manager Planning- PED
description:
It's about Being What's next.
**What's in it for you?**
An Associate General Manager - Planning will manage entire planning and scheduling of execution work to complete safely and within schedule. The purpose of this position is to effectively plan, schedule, monitor, and control project activities to ensure successful delivery of projects within the approved schedule, budget, scope, and quality requirements. The role is responsible for developing and maintaining integrated project schedules, tracking progress and performance, identifying critical activities and potential delays, and implementing timely recovery and mitigation strategies.
  
  
At Linde, the sky is not the limit. If you’re looking to build a career where your work reaches beyond your job description and betters the people with whom you work, the communities we serve, and the world in which we all live, at Linde, your opportunities are limitless. Be Linde. Be Limitless.
  
  
Team
  
  

Making an impact.
**What will you do?**

* In this role, you will develop, maintain, and manage integrated project schedules across engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and handover phases to ensure alignment with project objectives, contractual commitments, and execution strategies.
* Additionally, you will establish baseline schedules, track project progress against approved plans, analyze schedule variances, and implement timely corrective actions to ensure successful project delivery within approved timelines.
* Furthermore, you will perform critical path analysis, monitor critical and near-critical activities, identify potential schedule risks and delays, and recommend effective recovery and mitigation plans to minimize project impacts.
* Meanwhile, you will collaborate closely with Project Management, Engineering, Procurement, Construction, QA/QC, HSE, and other stakeholders to ensure seamless schedule integration, resource optimization, and effective project coordination.
* Consequently, you will monitor project performance, assess actual progress against planned targets, and provide accurate forecasting of milestones, deliverables, and project completion dates.
* Moreover, you will prepare and present daily, weekly, and monthly progress reports, dashboards, look-ahead schedules, and management updates to support informed decision-making and project governance.
* Finally, you will participate in project review meetings, communicate schedule performance, risks, and recovery strategies, and support the successful achievement of project scope, quality, budget, and schedule objectives.

Winning in your role.
**Do you have what it takes?**

* You must be having a bachelor’s degree in civil, mechanical, electrical, or related discipline and have at least 12–18 years of relevant experience in project planning and scheduling.

**Why you will love working for us!**
Linde is a leading global industrial gases and engineering company, operating in more than 100 countries worldwide. We live our mission of making our world more productive every day by providing high-quality solutions, technologies and services which are making our customers more successful and helping to sustain and protect our planet.
  
  
On the 1st of April 2020, Linde India Limited and Praxair India Private Limited successfully formed a joint venture, LSAS Services Private Limited. This company will provide Operations and Management (O&M) services to both existing organizations, which will continue to operate separately. LSAS carries forward the commitment towards sustainable development, championed by both legacy organizations. It also takes ahead the tradition of the development of processes and technologies that have revolutionized the industrial gases industry, serving a variety of end markets including chemicals & refining, food & beverage, electronics, healthcare, manufacturing, and primary metals.
  
  
At Linde, the sky is not the limit. If you’re looking to build a career where your work reaches beyond your job description and betters the people with whom you work, the communities we serve, and the world in which we all live, at Linde, your opportunities are limitless. Be Linde. Be Limitless.
  
  
Have we inspired you? Let's talk about it!
  
  
We are looking forward to receiving your complete application (motivation letter, CV, certificates) via our online job market.
  
  
Any designations used of course apply to persons of all genders. The form of speech used here is for simplicity only.
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other reason prohibited by applicable law.
  
  
Linde India Limited acts responsibly towards its shareholders, business partners, employees, society and the environment in every one of its business areas, regions and locations across the globe. title: Head, GCFO AI Lead(Singapore, India)
description: Job SummaryThis role could be based in Singapore or India. When you start the application process you will be presented with a drop down menu showing all countries, please ensure that you select a country where the role is based. The GCFO AI lead is accountable for transforming the Finance operating model through process excellence, re-engineering, intelligent automation, and artificial intelligence. The role leads the redesign and optimization of GCFO's end-to-end processes, controls, data, and operating model, embedding simplified, standardized, and scalable ways of working across the function. As the architect of Finance transformation, the role drives continuous improvement, productivity, control effectiveness, and digital innovation, creating a highly efficient, insight-led, and AI-enabled Finance organisation. Beyond GCFO, the role serves as the senior Finance representative across Bank-wide AI and transformation initiatives, ensuring GCFO priorities are reflected in the enterprise AI agenda while accelerating the adoption of responsible AI, automation, and emerging technologies across the function. Shape and deliver the long-term GCFO transformation agenda, translating strategic objectives into a coherent platform roadmap with clear outcomes, milestones, investment priorities, and measurable business value. Serve as the Finance and Treasury champion for enterprise-wide AI transformation, representing GCFO across Bank-wide AI initiatives, influencing cross-functional priorities, and ensuring alignment with the Bank's AI strategy. Partner with senior leaders across Finance, Risk, Technology, Operations, Data, and the Businesses to identify, prioritize, and scale AI opportunities that deliver sustainable productivity, control, and commercial benefits. Architect future-ready operating models that support business growth, enhance organizational agility, and reduce complexity, operational risk, and cost. Champion intelligent automation and digital transformation through the adoption of workflow technologies, RPA, AI/ML, agentic capabilities, and next-generation productivity solutions. Ensure alignment with Group Finance, Risk, Technology, Data, and regulatory strategies while maintaining strong governance, controls, resilience, and audit readiness across both traditional and digital-asset environments. Contribute to the development of the Bank's AI standards, governance frameworks, control environment, and Responsible AI practices, ensuring safe, ethical, and compliant adoption of AI across the enterprise. Monitor emerging AI technologies, regulatory developments, and industry-leading practices, identifying opportunities that advance Finance and Treasury capabilities while strengthening the Bank's competitive advantage.Business Strengthen GCFO’s business partnering model with Finance, Risk, Technology, and the wider business. Ensure GCFO PE and AI materially improves decision-making quality, speed, and insight through predictive, prescriptive, and generative analytics. Support growth, product innovation, and balance-sheet optimisation, including emerging tokenised financial products. Act decisively to address risk and control weaknesses, ensuring issues are remediated and escalated appropriately.Processes Process, Control & Organisation Layer: Establish integrated controllership and operating-model capabilities including iCon, ARIS, Signavio, ProHance, M7, CIMCON, ServiceNow, and WalkMe, embedding control-by-design and auditability. Drive standardisation & harmonisation of processes across regions & business units Drive technology enablement and integration across a complex systems landscape including SAP, non-SAP ERP applications, and emerging AI solutions, ensuring seamless data flow and process automation that reduces manual effort and strengthens controls. Pioneer the adoption of Agent AI and intelligent automation within controllership processes, evaluating use cases, managing implementation, and realizing measurable benefits in efficiency, accuracy, and strategic value delivery. Intelligence Layer: Deliver AI-enabled capabilities including Knowledge Graphs, vector stores, RAG, Digital Twins, LLMs, and Agents to enable advanced analytics and decision support across finance and digital-asset domains. Define defect prevention programs & implement mistake-proofing techniques across critical processesPeople & Talent Build and lead a high-performing GCFO Process excellence organisation spanning platform ownership, product management, data, AI, engineering, and digital-asset expertise. Develop future-ready GCFO talent and act as an evangelist for GCFO digital enablement, and AI adoption.Risk Management Reinforce an exemplary risk and control culture across all GCFO platforms and processes, including those supporting digital assets and tokenised products. Maintain compliance with key regulatory and financial reporting standards. Strengthen the control environment while driving process simplification and efficiency. Embed audit readiness through disciplined governance, documentation, and testing.Governance Establish control and review frameworks for GCFO platforms and processes, ensuring compliance with Group Control Governance and EUC policies. Define and update relevant policies, standards, and guidelines, and ensure platforms are benchmarked against industry best practice.Regulatory & Business Conduct Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct. Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, regulatory compliance, and business conduct across GCFO. Resolve audit and regulatory issues with sustainable, long-term solutions.Key stakeholders Group CFO and GCFO Leadership Team GCFO COO Management Team Group Finance, Risk, Technology, and Data Office Audit, Compliance, and Regulators Regional and Cluster CFOs.Our Ideal Candidate 20+ years of experience with a strong track record of transformation in Finance & Accounting including controllership , FP&A , Regulatory reporting etc Proven experience delivering large-scale finance transformation programmes in an international bank or equivalent regulated institution Strong understanding of Generative AI , LLMs , AI agents , Automation and Analytics Quantifiable benefits through cost reduction, productivity , faster close , better forecasting and controls Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and leadership skills. Experience integrating on-chain and off-chain data and distributed-ledger technologies into enterprise finance and risk platforms.
